decision: D-027 (option A = P2-U9 Outcome B; was O-22): Directive doesn't edit pnpm's config. P2-U9 removes #5860's writes to pnpm-workspace.yaml. When pnpm refuses an install as too new, Directive prints pnpm's own recovery steps (message to be built); when pnpm changed the file, Directive lists it under Review and commit. P2-U0 Q3: leave the row out of the ownership record. This repo's own exception row stays. Docs note: older pnpm 11 frozen installs in CI may fail for up to 24 h after a release. Tell Scott before the merge. No RC.
